Contact CRI

Corrections and methodology challenges get priority — they make the platform better for everyone.

Reach the right desk

  • Report an error: hila@victoryroofer.com — handled under our Corrections policy.
  • Methodology questions: same address, subject line “Methodology” — see how our numbers are built.
  • Research & data citations: subject line “Research” for dataset questions, citation permissions, and collaboration.
  • Press: subject line “Press.”
  • Phone: (954) 634-2028 — business hours, Eastern time.
A note on solicitation CRI does not accept paid placement, sponsored editorial, or link exchanges. Pitches of that kind will not receive a response.

Send a message

If reporting an error, include the page URL.

We reply to every message. If you would rather use email, write to hila@victoryroofer.com.
